description.value: Table: Summon Nature's Ally VII Creature Subtype(s) Ankheg (1/day Earthquake) — Death Hornet — Death Stalker — Elemental (Greater) (Elemental, Extraplanar) Garula — Greater Cait (6 MP) — Ironback — Leap Frog — Megalodon (Aquatic) Sea Devil (Aquatic) Sidhe (6 MP. 1/day Lethe Arrow, Summer Breeze, and White Wind) — This spell functions like Summon Nature’s Ally I , except that you can summon one creature from the 7th-level list with a CR rating of 10 or lower, 1d3 creatures of the same kind from the 6th-level list , or 1d4+1 creatures of the same kind from the 5th-level or lower lists.
